craft_notes: Sthāyin: sound-offering (hearing's garland). Rows: row 2 (honors→bow). Close: bow (line-end bow after honors-opener: verb arc). Rejected: 'listens' — killed: hearing-formed kept (śruti as faculty-name); comma-for-dash swap kept minimal (breath, not doctrine).

lines: Southwest enthroned she Bhairava honors with sound-blooms,
hearing-formed, ever her, Vaiṣṇavī power — bow.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nairṛtadalagā bhairavamarcayate śabdakusumairyā | praṇamāmi śrutirūpāṃ nityaṃ tāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ śaktim

reads_against.argmap: Who offers sounds? → Vaiṣṇavī (śruti/ear, Nirṛti petal) garlands sounds; edition śabda-flowers adopted (flower-pattern), variant śabdarūpā recorded.
c1_essence: Vaiṣṇavī hearing-formed offers sound-flowers from the southwest: listening itself the rite.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder circling home to rest)
